definitions.explanation: The process of reducing carbon dioxide emissions, particularly from fossil fuel use, to address climate change. Often refers to transitioning to renewable energy and low-carbon technologies.

examples.japanese: {脱炭素|だつたんそ}{社会|しゃかい}の{実現|じつげん}を{目指|めざ}す。
examples.english: To aim for the realization of a decarbonized society.

examples.japanese: {企業|きぎょう}が{脱炭素|だつたんそ}{経営|けいえい}に{取|と}り{組|く}む。
examples.english: Companies are working on decarbonization management.

examples.japanese: {脱炭素|だつたんそ}に{向|む}けて{再生可能|さいせいかのう}エネルギーを{導入|どうにゅう}する。
examples.english: To introduce renewable energy toward decarbonization.

examples.japanese: 2050{年|ねん}までに{脱炭素|だつたんそ}を{達成|たっせい}する{目標|もくひょう}を{掲|かか}げた。
examples.english: We set a goal to achieve decarbonization by 2050.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {脱|だつ} (escape from, removal) + {炭素|たんそ} (carbon). Literally "removing carbon."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{脱炭素|だつたんそ}{社会|しゃかい} (decarbonized society)
・{脱炭素|だつたんそ}{経営|けいえい} (decarbonization management)
・{脱炭素|だつたんそ}に{向|む}けて (toward decarbonization)
・{脱炭素|だつたんそ}{化|か} (decarbonization process)
・{脱炭素|だつたんそ}{宣言|せんげん} (decarbonization declaration)

JAPAN'S COMMITMENT: In 2020, Japan declared a goal of achieving カーボンニュートラル by 2050, driving major policy and business changes.

RELATED TERMS:
・カーボンニュートラル - carbon neutral
・{温室効果|おんしつこうか}ガス - greenhouse gas
・{再生可能|さいせいかのう}エネルギー - renewable energy
・{省|しょう}エネ - energy conservation
